Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-sell and list CloudForge on Redwood's marketplace. We want to lock a demo window and a dry-run so our SI delivery lead and your ops team have a clear runbook. High-level asks:

- One dry-run 48–72 hours prior (screen-share + quick failover check).
- Ops contact matrix: primary on-call + escalation (we can draft).

I can take the technical preflight and run the dry-run checklist. A couple of items I want called out so we don't block on the day of:
- Model variant / token limits: confirm which quantized model we'll demo and expected prompt lengths. If CloudForge expects >2k tokens we should pre-warm KV cache.
- Network egress: if CloudForge's demo pulls large assets we should coordinate S3 presigned links with limited TTL.
- Fallback model: we'll configure a lower-capacity fallback for the live demo; need written agreement to fallback behavior in the MAP.

I've added these notes to preflight-checklist.md (attached). Marcus
